$comment: Single source of truth for the vendored graphics packages. Consumed by
scripts/fetch-vendor.js (`npm run fetch-vendor`). Nothing else reads it.
sha256 values are lowercase hex of the exact bytes at `url`. A null hash
means nobody has pinned that asset yet: the fetcher warns, prints the hash
it computed, and continues -- paste that value back in here to pin it.

dependencies.name: plotly.js
dependencies.why: Rendering backend for the Blade Plots webview. Webviews are offline, so this file ships inside the .vsix and is tracked in git; the fetcher only verifies it.

dependencies.name: gr
dependencies.why: Static-PNG plotting backend for large grids, staged for a later release. 147 MB extracted, so it is gitignored and re-fetched on demand.
dependencies.runtime: GRDIR must point at dest and $GRDIR/bin must be on PATH (the Qt/GKS shared libraries live there).

win32-x64.note: MinGW build, matching the g++ toolchain the compiler shells out to. The MSVC variant (gr-0.73.26-Windows-x86_64-msvc.tar.gz) is deliberately not used.

linux-x64.note: Chosen over gr-0.73.26-Ubuntu-x86_64.tar.gz (90 MB, bundles a full Qt) and over the Linux/CentOS/Redhat x86_64 builds, which are byte-identical to each other at 48094182 and target an older glibc.

darwin-x64.note: Per-arch build. gr-0.73.26-Darwin-universal.tar.gz (90 MB) would cover both Macs in one asset if that is ever preferable.
